overview.title: Systems and durable decisions
overview.speaker: Synthetic Speaker
overview.executive_summary: The summary distinguishes local parts from the relationships that produce system-level behavior.

topic_map.explanation: System behavior depends on interactions, not only on isolated components.

examples.value: A reliable component can still fail inside a fragile workflow.

topic_map.why_it_matters: It changes where evaluation and intervention should happen.

key_points.explanation: Local tests do not reveal every interaction failure.
key_points.evidence: The source emphasizes relationships among parts.
key_points.practical_implication: Add scenario-level tests before optimizing isolated components.

frameworks.name: Relationship-first evaluation
frameworks.how_it_works: Measure outcomes at the level where interactions produce behavior.
frameworks.when_to_use: Use it when component metrics hide coordination failures.

examples.what_happened: A workflow passed isolated checks but failed in combination.
examples.illustrates: Interactions can create behavior absent from individual parts.
examples.lesson: Preserve uncertainty and test the assembled system.

immediate.value: Map the relationships before choosing an intervention.

strategic.value: Treat system-level outcomes as first-class evidence.

questions_to_investigate.value: Which interaction should be measured first?

claims_to_verify.claim: Relationship-level tests find failures that component tests can miss.
